values: 进行一段冲刺，随后向一个方向发射强力穿透箭。
Atalanta dashes forward and shoots a powerful penetrative bolt in a direction.
跳到目标格子处，短暂蓄力后向所选方向发射一支强力穿透箭，对1格宽路径上的所有敌人造成280% + 30% ATK伤害和2秒眩晕。
Atalanta selects a tile and dashes there, shooting a powerful penetrative bolt in the target direction, dealing 280% + 30% ATK damage to all enemies along a 1-tile wide path and stunning them for 2s.
本技能击中敌人时，还会在敌人位置引发“炽热赠礼”的爆炸效果，造成“炽热赠礼”技能75%的伤害。每次释放终极技能，每名敌人最多只会通过这种方式受到3次“炽热赠礼”的伤害。

When Atalanta hits an enemy with this skill, she triggers the explosion of Scorching Gift at the target's location, dealing 75% of the skill's damage. Scorching Gift can only deal damage 3 times to an enemy in this way each time Atalanta casts her Ultimate.
将一个敌人击退，若后方有其他敌人则会对二者均施加效果。
Atalanta knocks an enemy back. If another enemy is behind the target within range, skill's effects are applied to both of them.
挥动鞭子，对目标造成130% + 15% ATK伤害，将其击退2格并使其定身3秒。若在目标身后一定范围内有其他敌人，则改为将目标撞向范围内最近的一名敌人，并对目标和该敌人同时造成伤害和定身效果。

Atalanta swings her whip at an enemy, dealing 130% + 15% ATK damage, knocking them back 2 tiles, and immobilizing them for 3s. If there is another enemy behind the target within range, Atalanta will instead knock the target towards that enemy, dealing damage and immobilizing both of them.
若目标成功撞向了一名敌人，则还会对这两名敌人各自造成相当于对方攻击力150%的额外伤害，该伤害最高不超过阿塔兰忒300%攻击力。
If Atalanta knocks the target into another enemy, the two enemies take damage from each other. The damage received is equal to 150% of the other side's ATK, up to 300% of Atalanta's ATK.
Atalanta shoots a powerful explosive bolt.
向目标发射一支爆裂箭，命中后产生爆炸，对目标及其周围1格范围内的所有敌人造成190% + 20% ATK伤害。
Atalanta shoots an explosive bolt that explodes upon hitting an enemy, dealing 190% + 20% ATK damage to the target and adjacent enemies.
爆炸范围扩大至2格，但在爆炸最外圈的敌人受到的伤害只有原始伤害的60%。
The explosion range is increased to 2 tiles. However, enemies in the outermost circle of the explosion only take 60% of the original damage.
提高自身急速，短时间内对3名不同敌人造成伤害后进一步提升急速。
Atalanta's Haste increases during battle. She gains extra Haste after dealing damage to 3 different enemies within seconds.
战斗中，自身提高12点急速。当自己在连续3秒内对3个不同的敌人造成伤害后，额外提升2点急速。
Atalanta increases her Haste by 12 during battle. She gains an extra 2 Haste after dealing damage to 3 different enemies within 3s.
战斗中，自身提高15点急速。当自己在连续3秒内对3个不同的敌人造成伤害后，额外提升4点急速。
Atalanta increases her Haste by 15 during battle. She gains an extra 4 Haste after dealing damage to 3 different enemies within 3s.
战斗中，自身提高18点急速。当自己在连续3秒内对3个不同的敌人造成伤害后，额外提升6点急速。
Atalanta increases her Haste by 18 during battle. She gains an extra 6 Haste after dealing damage to 3 different enemies within 3s.
技能“甜蜜邂逅”在战斗开始时可以连续释放多次。
Sweet Encounter can be cast multiple times in a row when a battle starts.
战斗开始时，技能“甜蜜邂逅”可以连续使用2次，且优先对不同的目标释放。被动地，“甜蜜邂逅”造成的伤害提高6%。
Sweet Encounter can be cast 2 times in a row when a battle starts, prioritizing different targets. Passive. The damage dealt by Sweet Encounter is increased by 6%.
技能“甜蜜邂逅”的伤害加成比例提高至8%。
The bonus damage ratio of Sweet Encounter is increased to 8%.
每当自己使用“甜蜜邂逅”命中主目标时，阿塔兰忒还会顺手从目标身上“借”点值钱的东西——从目标身上吸取10%攻击力和10%护甲，该效果对同一目标不可叠加。该技能吸取的属性会在8秒后归还给对方。

Atalanta steals 10% ATK and 10% Phys DEF from the target every time she hits her main target with Sweet Encounter. This effect cannot be stacked on the same target, and the stolen stats will be returned in 8s.
技能“甜蜜邂逅”的伤害加成比例提高至10%。
The bonus damage ratio of Sweet Encounter is increased to 10%.
技能“狂野狙击”直接击中敌人时，为自身恢复生命。
Atalanta heals herself when Wild Sniper hits the enemy directly.
技能“狂野狙击”每直接击中一个敌人，为阿塔兰忒恢复10%的最大生命值。
Atalanta recovers 10% of max HP every time an enemy is directly hit by Wild Sniper.
阿塔兰忒在释放“甜蜜邂逅”期间处于霸体状态并提升60点急速，若目标成功撞向了一名敌人，还会使这两名敌人额外降低40%的护甲，持续8秒。
While casting Sweet Encounter, makes Atalanta unaffected and increases her Haste by 60. If Sweet Encounter knocks the target enemy into another, reduces both enemies' Phys DEF by 40% for 8s.
